scope: All 36 design section 6 IDs: 25 applicable wire/tool mutations, including cross-area catchers 3, 4, 5 and 36; 11 explicit later-pending mutations. Each applicable patch independently targets git archive REF_COMMIT, never HEAD or the working tree. Later-pending is not a kill, waiver or completed 36/36 gate.

later_pending.reason: Resume checksum corruption needs protected checkpoint fixtures.
Restored GC setting needs checkpoint and next recall/request fixtures; W52.gc/resume remain dependent.
Fork complete-batch boundary requires controlled child history fixtures; W13 native fork is dependent.
Sibling observation authority requires local stale/write authorization fixtures.
Settled ready-batch delivery order requires controlled publication barriers.
Parent finish refusal requires held live descendant fixtures.
Preserved exec_unknown requires oversized delivery and controlled effect fixtures.
GC latest-third-step preservation requires deterministic protected-record fixtures; W52.gc is dependent.

mutations.description: Choose maximum probability instead of cheapest sufficient cumulative route
mutations.intended_assertion: Route follows the cheapest cumulative .80 threshold, not classifier argmax
mutations.availability_note: threshold-below chooses between efforts on the same model, so an argmax mutant reaches the intended effort assertion instead of causing an unrelated unexpected-model provider failure.
